items.statement: Determine which nitrate coordination models of neutral singlet IrCl2(NO3)(PPh3)2 are supported by molecular stability and the supplied experimental IR observations. Test monodentate and bidentate candidates of the same composition, including necessary ligand-geometric alternatives, and determine whether the available evidence uniquely identifies a model.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Encoding eta2 as a fixed answer, removing or replacing ligands, fitting peak-specific scales, inventing nitrate mode character without vectors, or using one failed eta1 optimization to prove no eta1 basin exists.
